headline: Profit edges higher on cost actions while volumes decline
summary_short: Revenue fell 2% to $49.5B on 9% lower wholesales, but adjusted EBIT rose to $2.7B and adjusted EPS to $0.49. Ford raised the low end of 2026 adjusted EBIT guidance to $10.5B-$11B.
summary_long: Ford Blue EBIT was $1.4B, Ford Pro $1.7B, and Ford Model e lost $1.1B, an improvement of 25%. Ford Credit pre-tax earnings rose 27% to $803M. Operating cash flow was $5.4B. Free cash flow guidance stays $6B-$7B and capital spending $9.5B-$10.5B. The fourth-quarter dividend is 15 cents per share.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EBIT, adjusted EPS and adjusted free cash flow are non-GAAP. Year-ago GAAP net income benefited from a tax benefit, so GAAP and adjusted trends diverge. Deltas computed from the release's year-ago figures.

drivers.explanation: Wholesale units fell 9%; Ford Blue revenue fell 3% on lower volume from product discontinuations.
Ford Credit and cost actions offset lower Ford Blue and Ford Pro EBIT; Ford Blue was hit by lower volume, the Middle East conflict and higher commodity costs, partly offset by favorable mix.
CEO says cost actions and record growth in software services and parts demand support the path toward an 8% adjusted EBIT margin by 2029.
